depicts: Third-person view of armored knights fighting in a dark blocky stone arena, a blue glowing grid floor patch, fallen bodies, blood splats and dropped weapons.
composition: Wide arena view; fighters cluster left and centre, bodies along the bottom, a lone knight at centre-right. Large dark block wall fills the right edge; sky occupies a small top-right area.
tone_and_contrast: Mostly dark grey stone with a small pale-blue sky. Saturated red blood and the bright blue grid stand out strongly against the dark floor and walls.
sharpness_and_artifacts: Edges look clean at full size; slight soft texture on stone. Some compression smoothing in dark areas. No HUD, cursor or watermark visible. Bottom-left figure is partly cut off by the frame.
scan_first_read: A medieval knight melee with blood in a stone arena; the blue floor grid and red bodies read immediately.
